title: US economy grows at brisk 3.4% pace in third quarter on strong consumer spending and AI investment
description: The U.S. economy grew at a healthy 3.4% annual pace from July through September, accelerating from the second quarter on strong consumer spending and investment in artificial intelligence. The expansion in third-quarter gross domestic product – the nation’s output of goods and services – was faster than the 2.2% growth registered from April through June, the Commerce Department said Thursday. Consumer spending rose at a brisk 3.8% clip in the third quarter, and business investment was up sharply, reflecting the AI boom.

title: Nearly half of severely distressed generative AI users turn to chatbots for emotional support, study finds
description: A new study has found that almost one in three Israeli adults surveyed who use generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools reported seeking emotional support, coping advice or mental health assistance from platforms such as ChatGPT and Gemini. Among users experiencing severe psychological distress, that figure rose to nearly one in two, according to researchers from Tel-Hai University of Kiryat Shmona in the Galilee and collaborating institutions.

title: Adgully to Host FINIXX Summit & Awards 2026 on the Future of Finance, AI and Trust
description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], October 29: Adgully is set to host the FINIXX Summit & Awards 2026 on October 30, 2026, at Hotel Sahara Star, Mumbai, under the theme “The Next Era of Finance: AI, Trust and the Reinvention of BFSI.” The summit will examine how artificial intelligence, evolving consumer expectations, digital innovation, and changing approaches to customer engagement are transforming the banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) sector. The event will provide a platform for industry leaders to exchange perspectives on building customer trust, driving business growth and navigating the opportunities and challenges emerging in a rapidly evolving financial ecosystem.
